keys: Paging fix: `paginate` slices `offset..offset+limit`; regression test with 5 books where `GET /books?limit=2&offset=2` returns books 3 and 4; `node --test` passes

`GET /books/stats` returns 200 `{ total, onLoan, available, byAuthor }` (byAuthor sorted count desc, author asc), registered before `/books/:id`, listed in README table, tests added; `node --test` passes

`src/util/params.js` helper replaces every repeated "parse id or 400" block in handlers; messages/statuses identical; existing test files unchanged (`git diff --stat test/` shows only additions in new tests); `node --test` passes

README "API reference" section: one `### METHOD /path` per table row (11 endpoints), params/body rules, success status + example JSON, error statuses; check by grep count of `### ` headings vs table rows

`notes/status-codes.md`: `# Status codes`, table (Status, Error code, Raised in, Endpoints, Covered by a test), one row per status+code combo, `## Untested` section; coverage claims verified against test files
